errors.text: The hypothesis incorrectly retains sluggish diffusion, configurational entropy, and lattice distortion as the principal stabilizing mechanism, whereas the target system exhibits active diffusion and kinetically controlled evolution.
It does not identify the AuCoCuNiPt composition or the preferential surface segregation, melting, and evaporation of low-surface-energy Au and Cu.

The proposed initial state and synthesis route differ substantially from the target: homogeneous carbothermal-shock particles replace PLD-grown, sub-10 nm, multi-twinned or icosahedral FCC nanoparticles.
The experiment uses long isothermal annealing in inert gas rather than staged in situ heating under vacuum, which could suppress or alter the evaporation behavior central to the target result.
